recipes.label: Match headers and footers to template
recipes.summary: Gives every document your template's headers and footers, with each document's own section number and title filled in.

recipes.label: Remove headers and footers
recipes.summary: Removes the headers, the footers or both from every section.

recipes.label: Add or remove a watermark
recipes.summary: Draws your words faintly behind every page, or takes a watermark out.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Watermark words
fields.help: Exactly as they should appear; one line.

recipes.label: Swap the logo
recipes.summary: Replaces the logo in the headers with a picture you attach, fitted to the same space.

fields.name: old
fields.label: Old logo
fields.help: Attach the old logo too to swap only that picture.

recipes.label: Match body formatting to template
recipes.summary: Gives each document your template's outline styles and numbering, its page, its font, and lets the styles set paragraph spacing, indents and alignment. Words and tables stay as they are.

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Your template's style for each part of a section
fields.help: Read from your template; change any that is wrong.

fields.name: clear
fields.label: Let the styles set paragraph spacing, indents and alignment
fields.help: Clears those three where a paragraph sets its own. Bold, italic and underlined words stay.

recipes.label: Match font to template
recipes.summary: Sets the text in your template's body font and size; headings, notes and other sizes keep theirs.

recipes.label: Find and replace
recipes.summary: Replaces words you list with your replacements in the body, headers and footers.

fields.name: table
fields.label: Or a table of pairs (first column: find; second: replace)

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Accept all tracked changes
recipes.summary: Accepts every pending tracked change, so the copies are clean.

recipes.label: Remove all comments
recipes.summary: Removes every comment and its replies.

recipes.label: Remove highlighting
recipes.summary: Removes Word's highlighter colour from all text.

recipes.label: Remove hidden text
recipes.summary: Removes text Word hides with its Hidden font setting.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Remove empty paragraphs
recipes.summary: Removes blank lines from the body.

options.label: Keep one where several stand together

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Name files by section number and title
recipes.summary: Names each edited copy from its own section number and title.

recipes.label: Set the document title property
recipes.summary: Sets File → Info → Title from each document's own section number and title.

fields.name: pattern
fields.label: Title
fields.help: {number} and {title} stand for each document's own; the other words are yours.

recipes.label: Turn off Track Changes
recipes.summary: The copies open with Word's Track Changes setting off.
